name: com.alperenelbiz.dccbridge
description: Drives Blender, Photoshop and Substance 3D Painter from Unity to build game-ready assets: headless export with validation, palette atlases, seamless detail maps, and material assembly. Every tool is optional — the pipeline adapts to whichever ones you have.

samples.description: A starter palette, prop manifest and Blender builder script to copy into your project.
